name: Café de Coral Holdings Limited
summary: Café de Coral Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates quick service restaurants and casual dining chains in Hong Kong and Mainland China. It operates restaurants under the Café de Coral, Super Super Congee & Noodles, Oliver's Super Sandwiches, Shanghai Lao Lao, The Spaghetti House, and Mixian Sense brand names. The company also provides institutional catering services under the Asia Pacific Catering and Luncheon Star brands. In addition, it is involved in the property investment, and food processing and distribution businesses. Café de Coral Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong.
